messages:
Noah (eng-sre): quick follow-up from the top-level postmortem for the customer "Acero" Dedicated outage. Root cause summary: intermittent VPC peering flaps combined with NAT asymmetry on customer's edge produced session mismatches and tripped our isolation heuristics. Need concise owners, timelines, and short/medium-term mitigations.

Rina (eng-platform): I'll take the config validator work (catch asymmetrical NATs and missing static routes). Plan: validator CLI + gating CI for Dedicated. Target: 2026-04-16.

Bea (eng-runtime): I'll own the runtime fallback and sticky-session work. Short-term: add `--kv-fallback-on-peer-fail` flag + unit tests. ETA: 2026-04-09.

Carlos (customer-success): Acero asked for a short maintenance window tonight to reduce idle timers (300s->60s) and deprioritize unstable peers. They want rollback steps documented beforehand.

maintenance-bot: maintenance scheduled by Carlos: "Acero peering mitigation" 2026-04-08T23:30:00Z - 2026-04-08T23:50:00Z (ref: #maint-181234).

Noah (eng-sre): Action items (please paste tracker links / PRs into ticket comments):
- P1: Peer-flap detectors + alerting (owner: Noah) due: 2026-04-10 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4110
- P2: Runtime KV fallback & sticky-session (owner: Bea) due: 2026-04-09 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4111
- P3: On-prem config validator + CI gate (owner: Rina) due: 2026-04-16 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4112
- P4: Interim maint + comms + rollback doc (owner: Carlos) due: 2026-04-08 ticket: https://tracker.redwood/RD-4113

Rina (eng-platform): uploaded validator prototype to RD-4112. Quick example check: `redwood-validate --check-nat-symmetry acero-config.yaml` will fail on asymmetric translation. Marking as blocker for Dedicated onboarding.

Bea (eng-runtime): pushed failing unit test simulating NAT translation drift. log snippet: `[2026-04-01T02:12:08Z] conn 0x1af: src=10.4.5.6 translated=52.34.9.8 mismatch -> isolation`. Will link RD-4111 when PR opened.

Noah (eng-sre): I'll add a rollback play and page rule to RD-4110: `if peer_down > 120s then page SRE` and attach packet captures. Also creating a weekly follow-up cadence until all tickets closed (Fridays 14:00 UTC).

Carlos (customer-success): Acero accepted the maintenance and asked for the post-maintenance summary within 2 hours. I'll include the rollback steps and on-call contacts.

Bea (eng-runtime): priority order: P4 (during window) -> P2 -> P3 -> P1. Ping me if you want pairing on the runtime change. :white_check_mark:
